law_record.title: Obedience to devices for control of traffic (1)
law_record.text: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 484B.307 [NRS-484B-307-2a, NRS-484B-307-2b, NRS-484B-307-3a, NRS-484B-307-4a, NRS-484B-307-4b, NRS-484B-307-5a, NRS-484B-307-6a, NRS-484B-307-7a, NRS-484B-307-8a, NRS-484B-307-8b, NRS-484B-307-8c, NRS-484B-307-8d, NRS-484B-307-8e, NRS-484B-307-9a, NRS-484B-307-9b, NRS-484B-307-9c, NRS-484B-307-11, NRS-484B-307-12a, NRS-484B-307-12b], it is unlawful for any driver to disobey the instructions of any official traffic-control device placed in accordance with the provisions of chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, unless at the time otherwise directed by a police officer.

activation_conditions: an official traffic-control device governs the subject's approach or lane
the device is placed under the traffic chapters
exceptions: when otherwise directed by a police officer at the time
the signal rules the text cites govern the specific indications
residue: this line is the general obedience duty: what counts as disobedience is fixed by the device-specific rules, several of which it cites
whether a device was 'placed in accordance with' the chapters is an administrative fact, not observable
the text cites NRS 484B.307(11), which is outside the corpus (removed_target)
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: obedience is owed for as long as the device governs the subject
the device's instruction must be observable to the subject before the conduct judged
